The existing ved_electrical database, checked against the project models.
Each full table appears once. Small related-table boxes repeat a key as a continuation reference.
Read a relationship from left to right

The FK column on the left refers to the PK in the small box on the right.
See page NN tells you where that related table is shown in full.

PK = primary key: uniquely identifies a row.   FK = foreign key: refers to another table.
UQ = unique value.   UQ together = the combination must be unique.   NULL? Yes = optional.

1 = exactly one.   0..1 = zero or one.   0..many = zero or more.
Example: many projects can refer to one user; each project must have one owner.

Only declared foreign keys have connectors. No relationship is inferred from a field name.
MariaDB stores JSON as LONGTEXT; boolean fields appear as TINYINT. Full metadata accompanies this file.
Continuation boxes represent existing tables, not additional tables. Lines are relationships, not workflow arrows.
